Episode 218. Structure Where a Stronger One Comes After Defeating One (2)
The sea called the Sea of Swords by the Hufester Alliance and the Sea of Magic by the Lutero Magic Federation.
In the middle of it were the garrisons of the demonic world. It was as if the demonic world had taken over the area, which was virtually treated as neutral waters.
"Master, isn't it too dangerous for just the two of you to go?"
As Kashimir spoke, Luna, who was next to him, shook her head instead.
"It's not dangerous, Your Majesty. Even if the full force of the demonic world suddenly springs up, both the youngest and Lord Murakan can easily escape."
"Right. The Golden Fleet will be on standby nearby anyway, so you don't have to worry too much."
"Things fall apart if too many people go. Minnow, you should stay in the control room and receive reports."
"Murakan, even though he is Kashimir, he's the king of a nation and could perhaps soon be the emperor of the empire. Is it okay to keep calling him a minnow like that?"
When Ameris defended him, Kashimir broke into a broad smile.
"It's a nickname, so let's not interfere with it, Mr. Ameris. Let's go, kid!"
"Everyone, start your missions. Your Majesty, please contact me immediately if anything unusual happens during your tasks."
Jin raised a small metal plate from the pocket of his coat. It was the 'portable' communication device finally completed by Kwall.
It had been distributed to all the major transcendent beings in the alliance, including Jin, and was scheduled to be supplied to all commanders throughout the area this week.
"Understood, Master. Take care."
Those gathered in the conference room dispersed quickly.
This time, Jin did not use the Red Owl. With many mission areas, the Red Owl had to be used alternately by other colleagues.
[Haha, a dragon must appear to the enemies by flying. That's when it feels the best.]
"I was worried you might vomit in front of the demons."
[Heh, hold on tight. We'll go at top speed.]
"It's been a while since I've ridden you for a long journey."
As Murakan flapped his wings once, a huge hole was made in the cloud, and a shockwave occurred. Murakan cut through the sky in an instant at a much faster speed than the wind dragons.
At this speed, it would take about three hours to arrive at the garrison of the demonic world.
If it were another ordinary dragon or airship, it would have taken about six hours. That meant, as soon as the barrier was broken, the enemies could attack Tikan at any time.
However, even if they break through the barrier and come in, the top transcendent beings of Barmel and defense equipment are always on standby in Tikan.
'The enemies have settled nearby, but it's not too burdensome.'
This was because the fruits of their preparations since the preliminary period were starting to shine.
Although the war hadn't fully started yet, Jin was enveloped in a certainty that he couldn't possibly lose.
'The enemy tribes and the Demon Realm. Underground forces have started to play their cards in earnest, but the biggest enemy of the clans, the alliance, and me is still Ziphil.'
The cold wind was chilling his head.
Two hours after they started flying, they received their first communication from Kashmir.
{Teacher, can you hear me well?}
"I hear you well."

{I just got a report from the 1st and 3rd batches. All major cracks in the south of Delki have been removed, and there are seven medium and small cracks left. However, it was decided that hunting after the transfer was more efficient than removing the medium and small cracks.}

"Yes, that would be best. Since there's a limit to the number of times your sister can use her secret technique, it would be a waste to eliminate medium and small cracks. Civilian evacuation should have been finished a long time ago. How about other mission areas?"

{It seems that Turben and Heijin are suppressing the major cracks in the Kingdom of Schucheron without difficulty, and the 7th, 10th, and 11th batches seem to be having some trouble. There are no special problems in other places yet.}
"Understood."
Another hour passed.
Jin and Murakan were verifying the Demon Realm's garrison, which had started to appear far away.
[Wow... Look at these guys. It's already the size of a small country, isn't it? It might be bigger than the whole empire.]
As Murakan said, the garrison of the Demon Realm summoned on the sea was large enough to be called a 'nation'.
The Alliance had already destroyed dozens of castles that were teleported through several battles and defeated tens of thousands of soldiers and many generals of the demon race.

Considering the overall scale of the Demon Realm, it was a drop in the bucket. The central garrison that the two are looking at now is just a result of a very small part of the Demon Realm being summoned.

The entire garrison was overflowing with purple magic power, like a barrier. Magic power, which was like a deadly poison to those who were not properly trained, therefore, combat personnel below 6-star couldn't even enter the garrison.
"The minimum standard to be able to fight while exposed to magic power would be about 7-star. To be unaffected and use your full strength, it might be possible from 9-star."

[When we fight a full-scale war in the future, we will only select the best of the best, so that won't be a problem. Of course, by then, the magic power might be denser, but by then we should have mass-produced things like the Golden Fleet. Then we can push in with cannons from long-range.]
"You do think about strategy, Murakan."

[It's not a world where everything works just because I'm strong anymore. Well, it was the same a thousand years ago... Even at my peak, I couldn't protect my comrades. Ah, let's skip the heartbreaking story. It seems like the welcome party is about to start.]
The welcoming ceremony, of course, meant activating all sorts of magical traps and defensive equipment installed in the garrison.
As Murakan approached closer to the garrison, the magic spread around the area moved like a living organism, forming a huge magical circle. It was a form of dark magic that he had never seen before.
However, it wasn't difficult to figure out what the magic circle meant.
"Usually, it takes a long time to cast and the formula is complex like this, it's a curse system."
[And you are immune.]
As soon as Murakan answered, the magic condensed in the magical circle transformed into hundreds of thin tentacles and rushed towards Jin.
They could have avoided it, but Jin and Murakan intentionally took the curse all over their bodies. The tentacles attempting to pierce Jin suddenly wilted like a withered flower.

Then, the magical circle immediately transformed into a new shape. This time it was an offensive magic, but Jin didn't even need to draw his sword. The breath that Murakan exhaled with all his might was offsetting everything.
The boundary magic continued in this way, but it was unable to pressure the two who were close to Changseong.
So, just when the irritation was rising and he was about to draw his sword, the huge magic that blocked his view suddenly disappeared, revealing the true appearance of the garrison.
'Zito and the demons from the underworld. They have quite the taste.'
The garrison had a structure no different from a typical city.
However, each building was wrapped in thorny bushes, and despite Jin and Murakan floating quite high in the air, they could hear the horrible screams coming endlessly from below.

These were the screams of the dead who had not ascended to the afterlife and were trapped in hell. Looking closely, they could see the shapes of the souls hung around the city streets and squares. They looked like the old heroes resurrected by Hyeongsin in their lifetime, but they had a translucent, purple glow.
The demons summoned to the garrison were thus torturing human souls in their daily lives.
Of course, they were once living humans, so a feeling of pity arose for a moment.
According to Ameris and Tes, those who fell into hell are all those who committed a sin worthy of it in their lifetime.
In particular, Tes even told Jin that there was no need to feel pity for them. Only those who committed horrible crimes beyond your imagination fall into hell.
The fact that there were so many villains like this made him feel frustrated all over again.
[Kiddo, it seems like someone who could be called a responsible party is about to come out.]
The disappeared magic was now concentrated in a dimensional door formed right in the middle of the garrison's sky. A demon walked slowly out of the dimensional door, revealing its form.
"Hello, Lord Jin Run Kandel. My name is Sakiel Grosh."
[We don't need someone like you who we've never heard of. Bring me the one called Paelito Belgasium or whatever.]
At Murakan's provocation, Sakiel slowly shook his head.
"I had no idea you two would suddenly visit our demon realm. So I didn't properly prepare a welcoming ceremony. You should be busy organizing the mainland right now..."
[We'll handle our business, just call the strongest guy. Let's get it on now.]
Murakan was serious.
Jin had the intention to cross swords with the so-called Best Swordsman of the Demon Realm while he was here. Even if he didn't settle the score, he needed to gauge his battle power in advance.

"I can't do that. I too carry the heavy responsibility of being the secretary-general of the demon realm, so you should be satisfied with meeting me. However, shouldn't you two hurry back? Especially if you care about your comrades."
As soon as Sakiel said that, the communication device started to vibrate.

{Master Jin, cohorts 7, 10, and 11 have requested support. After suppressing the demons emerging from the rift, a new large rift suddenly formed on the battlefield, and stronger demons and troops are pouring out...!}
Sakiel had been directly monitoring the combat situation of all the rifts until he welcomed Jin and Murakan.

From the start, the rifts formed in the mainland by the demon realm were merely 'first phase'. When the superhumans of the alliance were dispersed for suppression, the demon realm planned to form a 'second phase' rift to pressure the scattered superhumans.
"Ah, so the transitory rifts formed in the mainland this time are designed to produce stronger enemies when defeated. I see...."
When Jin sighed and spoke, Sakiel gave a faint smile.
"There are still many prepared rifts. Rather than wasting precious time here, you should go back. After all, we will see each other plenty in the future."
At his words, Jin also grinned.
"Is that so?"
Just as Sakiel was about to reply, Jin picked up the communication device first.
"Luna, Runtia. You heard that, right?"
The two had eliminated the large rift before Jin and Murakan arrived at the demon realm base, even clearing all remnants of the smaller rifts.
And they had just wiped out the large rift that had newly opened at Sakiel's command.
Sakiel had personally confirmed this situation, which had surfaced in real-time on his crystal ball.
'... What? The new rift I just sent out, gone in one blow?'
{This is cohort 1. Yes, we heard you, Master. We will immediately coordinate with Master Sagung and move to Delkiro.}
Soon after, Jin nodded at Sakiel.
"What will you do, Sakiel? We also send stronger people when someone falls."
